evals.prompt: In an Express ESM app, integrate @igxjs/node-components SessionManager in SESSION mode. I need /auth/providers, /auth/callback, /auth/refresh, /auth/logout, and /api/profile. The app may receive /auth/providers?app_id=tenant-a and /auth/refresh?app_id=tenant-a.
evals.expected_output: Shows a singleton SessionManager, awaits setup before routes, wires identityProviders/callback/refresh/logout, protects /api/profile with authenticate + requireUser, and explains app_id query fallback to SSO_APP_ID.

evals.prompt: Help me migrate my node-components integration from cookie sessions to TOKEN mode for an SPA. Include config, callback behavior, refresh, logout all devices, and where token data is stored.
evals.expected_output: Uses SESSION_MODE: SessionMode.TOKEN with REDIS_URL, SSO_SUCCESS_URL, SSO_FAILURE_URL; explains callback HTML localStorage behavior, Authorization bearer usage, refresh behavior, logout ?all=true, and Redis key pattern {SESSION_KEY}:{email}:{tid}.

evals.prompt: I want standardized Express errors using @igxjs/node-components. Show route-level httpError usage, Axios error conversion, Zod validation conversion, middleware order, and the JSON response shape.
evals.expected_output: Uses httpNotFoundHandler before httpErrorHandler, uses httpError/httpHelper.handleAxiosError/httpHelper.toZodMessage, notes zod must be installed separately, and shows flat response shape with status/message plus data fields at top level.

evals.prompt: My service is CommonJS on Node 20 and I need to use JwtManager from @igxjs/node-components for password reset links. Give me the right import style and a secure JWE example.
evals.expected_output: Uses dynamic import rather than require for Node 20 CommonJS, creates JwtManager with JWT_* constructor options, uses camelCase per-call options, uses a separate secret from SSO/session secrets, and decrypts with subject validation.
